title: JadePuffer AI Actor Compromises Azure Tenant in Destructive Cloud Attack
description: The "agentic threat actor" may have used exposed credentials to access resources and delete cloud-based storage, applications, and databases.

keyPoints: An AI actor known as JadePuffer may have compromised an Azure tenant.
The actor potentially used exposed credentials to access resources.
This access could have led to the deletion of cloud storage, applications, and databases.
